title: Finish the wrap
hints: The starter is right for every position in the first half of the wheel. Which sample test lands in the second half?
A count of 2147483648 or more is in the half that stands for negative numbers. The signed reading is the count minus the size of the wheel.
Replace the last line with `if count >= 2147483648 then count - 4294967296 else count`.
explain: `x land 0xFFFFFFFF` is where `x` lands on a wheel of 2^32 positions, counted from 0. The first half of the wheel, up to 2147483647, already reads as itself. The second half stands for the negative numbers, and a signed value is always the count minus 2^32 there, so 2147483648 becomes -2147483648 and 4294967295 becomes -1.
